## Gap analysis vs spec
- §5c.1 landed: the vocabulary, six reserved slots + floors/tiers,
  `Layout`/`link_layout` (LC-1/LC-3 halves — see ADR-0254 §3 for the
  tier-legality reading), `ContextPolicy`/`PolicyDeclaration`/`default`,
  the `assemble` pipeline, `ContextWindowExceeded → stop`, and the
  `context.assembled`/`context.artefact.*`/`context.retrieval.completed`
  payload builders + class registrations. Compaction machinery is
  Stage-2 (R-2.4.2¹) — deferred.
- §5c.3 C0 slice landed: `MemoryStore` (`put`/`bind`/`revoke`/`resolve`/
  `manifest`/`enumerate`/`stale_candidates`), `Memory`/`Artifact`, scope
  leases + generation fencing, `lexical_index`, deterministic `retrieve`
  with the attested filter order, `RetrievalBudget` cut, the
  `context.memory.{written,invalidated,read}` audit rows +
  `context.retrieval.completed` report. Consolidation, `resume_set`
  consumers, non-lexical indexes — deferred (DF-S1.19-1).
- §5c.4 C0 slice landed: `lifecycle_state` (the
  `revoked > superseded > expired > stale > {valid|unknown}` chain),
  `check_contract`, `filter_for_slot` (E2 — `validity → authority →
  readers` attested), `write` (E4 — the `put` order), conflict sets,
  `promote`/`revalidate`/`resolve_conflict`, `MemoryStaleIndex`/
  `MemoryUsage`/`LexicalIndex` views.
- Out of scope held: no compaction pipeline, no turn-loop emitters, no
  renderer (`ProviderRequestPlan` assembly is §5b's).

## CC1–CC10 analysis
- **CC1** — one canonicalizer (`hh-wire`), one identity scheme
  (`idp("context_plan", …)`, `idp("memory", …)`), one label type
  (`hh-provenance::Label`); no parallel schemes introduced.
- **CC2** — authority is conferred: floors/min-authority are checked
  against the joined label, never read from content; `promote` confers
  `to_authority` through the endorsement basis only.
- **CC3** — every candidate is planned, omitted-with-reason, or a typed
  refusal; every retrieved item is `delivered` or `withheld{reason}`;
  `filter_order_attestation` records the check order.
- **CC4** — all records are canonical closed sums/records over
  `hh_wire::Json`; strict decoders refuse unknown members.
- **CC5** — contract-only reach: the store reads `contract`/`validity`/
  `justifications`, never payload content, for lifecycle decisions.
- **CC6** — tiers are kernel-fixed on the reserved slots; `static` admits
  no volatile kind; the `transcript` tier owns `transcript_item`.
- **CC7** — `MemoryContent::Text` reuses `hh-hir`'s `Text` leaf (the one
  prose type); no second text type.
- **CC8** — additive only: `RecordKind`/`ViewKind`/`CLASS_TABLE` gained
  members; no landed contract rewritten (the `pending` test in
  hh-telemetry was re-pointed to a still-pending class, not weakened).
- **CC9** — `RetrievalBudget{tokens,k}` is enforced by the declared
  estimator; over-budget items are `withheld`, never silently dropped.
- **CC10** — `hh-context` owns the context/memory plane; views are
  owner-projected (`Store::project` refuses the new kinds in-crate);
  provenance/authority/identity stay in their crates.

## Deviations
- ADR-0254 — crate boundary; the six-slot/floor table; the `link_layout`
  LC-1/LC-3 check assignment (tier legality, not tier monotonicity); the
  `assemble` pipeline order; `PolicyViolation` semantics;
  `ContextWindowExceeded → stop` at Stage 0/1; the three `context.*`
  class registrations as non-audit `row_prov` rows.
- ADR-0255 — the `put` check order; `pub(crate) put_inner(endorsed)` as
  the only authority-check waiver; `unknown` when nothing is checkable;
  `resolve(execute)` serving `{valid, stale_by_dependency, unknown}`;
  transitive stale-by-dependency; the `RecordKind`/`ViewKind`
  registrations.
- No spec-text deviations: every ruling disambiguates within the spec's
  own staging.
